text: ጂንካ ውስጥ ትኩሳት እና ድንገተኛ ሞት ሪፖርት ተደርጓል — unexplained deaths and fever reported near Jinka
Jinka: marburg የሚመስል ሁኔታ? fever cases rising, health office informed
በጂንካ አካባቢ ወረርሽኝ መሰል ምልክቶች — several sudden deaths, families alarmed
Moyale: first suspected mpox case with skin lesions and fever, traveller from Kenya side
ሞያሌ — mpox alert, patient isolated, contacts being traced
Bahir Dar area: cholera suspected at a holy water site, severe diarrhea and vomiting cases admitted
ባሕር ዳር — ኮሌራ ተጠርጥሯል፣ ተቅማጥ ያለባቸው ሰዎች ወደ ሆስፒታል ገብተዋል
Weather: rain expected over Gondar this week, farmers welcome it
